name: Kalshi BTC standardized moneyness
description: The standardized moneyness statistic d for the bound Kalshi market: d equals the natural logarithm of reference over strike divided by sigma_per_second times the square root of tau_seconds, all in pinned exact-decimal arithmetic with no floating point. sigma_per_second is volatility_bps_15s divided by ten thousand; tau_seconds is the remaining time to the rules-card close. The realized volatility and window delta are computed inside this process by their identical published code paths and are pinned here as signal-kind inputs alongside the market_contract rules card. The update is non-ready with a distinct reason when volatility is warming or zero, when tau_seconds is not positive, or when reference over strike leaves the model domain of 0.25 to 4.0 (model_domain_exceeded). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
